Subject: Licence keys and the trial
Date: Wednesday 28 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Rosa Delaney <rosa.delaney@brightmoor.example.test>

Rosa,

Two separate things.

Gus at Wyndham tells me he will send your team the environment details this week, so that one is between you.

On our trial, I will send you our evaluation criteria by Friday.

Best,
Dom

expected.description: Send Rosa Delaney the evaluation criteria for the trial
expected.evidenceQuote: I will send you our evaluation criteria by Friday.

notes: A third party promise sits beside a genuine outbound commitment.
